items.title: When to Choose Which
items.text: Choose term life if you want affordable, high coverage for temporary needs like raising children, replacing income, or paying off a mortgage. Choose whole life if you want lifelong coverage, permanent estate or dependent support (such as a dependent with special needs), or forced cash-value accumulation.
